review: Loads the global object, clears only bit 3 of byte +24, and selects ring mode from byte +8 bit 5. The ring branch keeps wrapped signed subtraction/division/multiply-add behavior and calls the flush child without using its result; the linear branch uses signed capacity arithmetic and the grow child. Both paths reload the object/buffer before advancing index by request*2 and publishing the updated word. The null/global and child boundaries remain opaque.
limitations: Pinned byte replay passes; branch/arithmetic and memory operation ordering checked against decoded instructions.
Ring division-by-zero behavior, child semantics, buffer lifetime, allocator ownership, alias/fault behavior and physical behavior are unresolved. No admission or gate change.
